title: Size bound for a parity circuit
statement: For every integer $m\\ge 7$, the circuit constructed from blocks of $2m$ parity coordinates and the parity conjunctive normal form on $m$ variables has size at most $m2^{2m}+2^m$.
caveat: The formal statement bounds the size of a specifically defined circuit, but the supplied informal descriptions omit the construction details needed to identify that circuit fully.
